concepts.definition: The ACNC registration status of the charity as published in the Annual Information Statement, including revocation reasons such as voluntary revocation or double defaulter. This is a charity-regulator status, not a company legal status or a licence status.
values: Voluntarily Revoked Not Entitled To Be A Charity
concepts.why_not_existing: entity.status is a coarse company-lifecycle enum (active/deregistered/in_liquidation/suspended/unknown) owned by business; ACNC charity registration states carry regulator-specific revocation reasons and belong to the charity role, so reuse would change meaning and owner. ext.licence.status is a licence status, not charity registration.

concepts.definition: Flag published by the ACNC indicating whether the charity is a basic religious charity for the reporting year, recorded as y/n in the source.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers ACNC basic religious charity classification; ext.entity.tax_concession covers PBI/HPC/DGR concessions, a different regulatory attribute.

concepts.definition: Flag published by the ACNC indicating whether the charity is an incorporated association, recorded as y/n. This is a self-reported association attribute, not an inference of legal form from the charity name.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept records incorporated-association status; entity legal form is not otherwise modelled and must not be inferred from names.

concepts.definition: State or territory incorporated-association registration number held by the charity, qualified by the jurisdiction whose association-number column supplied it. Values are publisher-formatted strings (e.g. INC9886754, A0005374L) and are not normalised across states.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.entity.prior_registration_number is a single legacy state registration number with no jurisdiction qualifier and no multi-value scope; the ACNC file holds up to eight jurisdiction-specific association numbers per charity, so reuse would lose the jurisdiction and multiplicity. ext.entity.prior_registration_state is a state name, not a number.
